exec sh -c '( sleep 5 && nc_self=$(exec sh -c '\''echo $PPID'\'' 2>/dev/null) && nc_tree=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$$" -v self="$nc_self" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\'') && kill -9 $nc_tree "$$" 2>/dev/null ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & nc_watchdog_pid=$!; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || uname -a; nc_status=$?; nc_kids=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$nc_watchdog_pid" -v self="-1" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\''); kill -9 $nc_kids "$nc_watchdog_pid" 2>/dev/null; exit $nc_status'
